unity_scene_verification: Root agent owns Unity integration; this review covers PNG artwork only.
method: Viewed raw images, then white/dark/sky composites. Buffs also viewed at exact 40px on all three backgrounds. No RGB/alpha cleanup, recoloring, or source image resampling.

SPR_UI_DS_TitleLogo.png.observations: Reads DeepSleep, including all four e glyphs, both p descenders and capital S. No clipped letters. D whale-tail ornament, final rice-grain flourish and white interiors retained. Transparent counters; no opaque plate or checkerboard. Dark and sky backgrounds show clean white/blue lettering.
SPR_UI_DS_TitleLogo.png.limitations: Final menu size/readability must be inspected in Unity; decorative logo is not substitute for accessible text naming.

SPR_UI_HA_TitleLogo.png.observations: Reads DeepSleep, all letters complete. Dark left ornament and red flower remain intact. No clipped p descenders or S loop. Native transparent counters; no baked checkerboard or background plate.
SPR_UI_HA_TitleLogo.png.limitations: Dark ornamental silhouette is subtle on dark backgrounds; cream lettering remains legible. Final menu layout pending Unity.

BG_UI_DS_MainMenu.png.result: Suitable for static menu integration review
BG_UI_DS_MainMenu.png.observations: Opaque blue cloud-sea panorama, quiet left/central upper region, brighter right horizon. No text, figures, or alpha holes. Canvas unchanged.
BG_UI_DS_MainMenu.png.limitations: Decorative menu background only, not seamless world-scroll art. Use aspect-preserving cover/crop; check ultrawide and 16:9 framing.

BG_UI_HA_MainMenu.png.result: Suitable for static menu integration review
BG_UI_HA_MainMenu.png.observations: Opaque charcoal/cream/red cloud-sea panorama with low corner foliage and bright right clouds. No text, figures, or alpha holes. Canvas unchanged.
BG_UI_HA_MainMenu.png.limitations: Decorative menu background only, not seamless world-scroll art. Use aspect-preserving cover/crop; check ultrawide and 16:9 framing.

ICO_BUFF_FaultToleranceExpansion.png.observations: 40px heart shape and support brackets recognizable. Native soft green glow preserved. No checkerboard or dark residue. White foreground stays intact.
ICO_BUFF_FaultToleranceExpansion.png.limitations: Light green/cream contrast is lower on pure white; dark/sky HUD backing improves reading. Fine facets disappear at 40px as expected.

ICO_BUFF_DataCompression.png.observations: Elongated white rice-grain energy projectile, blue-white trail, ring and inward-corner symbols. No triangular nori rice ball. At 40px ring distinguishes it from RiceStorm.
ICO_BUFF_DataCompression.png.limitations: Corner arrows become small at 40px; do not rely on them alone without label/tooltip. Native blue glow preserved.

ICO_BUFF_RiceFan.png.observations: Three white rice-grain energy projectiles with blue-white fan trails remain distinct at 40px. No triangular nori rice ball. Transparent spaces between all three trajectories.
ICO_BUFF_RiceFan.png.limitations: Native blue glow preserved; no threshold cleanup.

ICO_BUFF_RiceStorm.png.observations: Single white rice-grain energy projectile with long blue-white speed trails. No triangular nori rice ball. At 40px long diagonal silhouette reads separately from ringed DataCompression.
ICO_BUFF_RiceStorm.png.limitations: Slender shape has less filled area than the heart icon; use same square canvas, do not nonuniformly stretch.

ICO_BUFF_RiceGuidance.png.observations: Three target reticles with white rice grains, connected by a blue-white trajectory. Transparent gaps preserved. At 40px triple-reticle silhouette remains recognizable on all three backgrounds.
ICO_BUFF_RiceGuidance.png.limitations: Small target interior decorations are not readable at 40px; retain the hover/detail label.

ICO_BUFF_RiceSplash.png.observations: Five white rice grains arranged radially around a blue-white impact star. It occupies less canvas than the other icons, but exact 40px preview still clearly shows the five-grain radial burst (roughly 26px visible diameter). No cleanup or scale adjustment was needed.
ICO_BUFF_RiceSplash.png.limitations: Optical weight is smaller than RiceGuard/TerminalArray. Inspect final HUD before deciding whether a configured uniform visual scale is appropriate; source canvas stays unchanged.

ICO_BUFF_RiceGuard.png.observations: Full bowl of separate white rice grains, dark/gold bowl, two blue defensive arcs. At 40px bowl and shield-like arcs are clear. Dark bowl is retained, not incorrectly keyed away.
ICO_BUFF_RiceGuard.png.limitations: Individual rice grains merge into a white mound at 40px, as expected; bowl/arc silhouette carries the icon.

ICO_BUFF_QuantumSword.png.observations: Black-red sword with white energy core and sweeping red arc. Native glow and dark hilt retained. Sword tip and hilt are fully inside canvas. 40px diagonal sword silhouette is distinct.
ICO_BUFF_QuantumSword.png.limitations: Fine blade/hilt facets disappear at 40px; long thin silhouette has less filled area than terminal icons.

ICO_BUFF_TerminalAmplifier.png.observations: Single black-red terminal emitter and broad red-white beam. Dark body and white core intact. At 40px broad beam distinguishes it from TerminalBurst.
ICO_BUFF_TerminalAmplifier.png.limitations: Tiny expansion chevrons are secondary; retain text labels for exact effect semantics.

ICO_BUFF_TerminalArray.png.observations: Three separate black-red terminals and three beams converging at a bright point. Transparent gaps and three-emitter count preserved, including at 40px.
ICO_BUFF_TerminalArray.png.limitations: The image communicates multi-emitter array rather than exact combat beam geometry.

ICO_BUFF_TerminalBurst.png.observations: Single terminal and three separated red-white pulses on a diagonal trajectory. 40px pulse grouping stays distinguishable from broad TerminalAmplifier beam. Native red glow preserved.
ICO_BUFF_TerminalBurst.png.limitations: Slim pulse train is lower visual weight than amplifier; no nonuniform stretching or canvas crop applied.

ICO_BUFF_TerminalChain.png.observations: Large black-red terminal links to two red crystal nodes. At 40px branching links and two node bodies are clear. Dark terminal geometry remains intact on white, dark, and sky backgrounds.
ICO_BUFF_TerminalChain.png.limitations: Fine crystal textures disappear at 40px; branching silhouette remains the cue.
